regions.overview: The Ruins is dominated by Unholy skeletons. Backline stress and ranged attackers are usually more urgent than the durable but low-pressure frontline defenders.

commonThreats.description: Bone Courtiers and shared stress dealers can create lasting expedition risk from the back ranks.
Bone Arbalists attack from safety and become more dangerous when attacking marked heroes.
counters: Pull the Arbalist into a weak forward attack pattern

commonThreats.description: Bone Defenders and later Bone Captains can absorb direct damage while more urgent enemies act behind them.
counters: Attack or disable the backline first

commonThreats.description: Veteran and Champion enemies add party-wide attacks, stuns, movement, buffs, and corpse revival.

resistanceTendencies.note: Ruins-specific skeletons are effectively unsuitable bleed targets.
Skeletons are generally vulnerable to blight, though resistance rises with expedition difficulty.
Backline skeletons begin vulnerable to stun, while large and higher-tier enemies resist it more strongly.
Courtier and Arbalist can be disrupted by movement, while Defender, Captain, and Bearer are less practical move targets.

recommendedCapabilities: Clear corpses before Bone Bearer revival
cautions: Do not build the party's primary damage plan around bleed.
Do not spend early turns grinding through a Bone Defender while a Courtier or Arbalist remains active.
Champion expeditions require an immediate plan for Bone Bearer and its corpse revival.

regions.overview: The Warrens is dominated by Human and Beast Swinefolk. Fast backline enemies spread stress, disease, marks, and party disruption while tougher frontliners exploit the resulting openings.

commonThreats.description: Swine Wretches attack quickly from the back ranks, inflicting stress and potentially a random disease on any hero.
Swine Drummers mark heroes and reduce dodge, enabling dangerous follow-up attacks from other Warrens enemies.
Choppers, Swinetaurs, and Skivers can stun, knock heroes back, or pressure multiple party positions at once.
counters: Control high-impact enemies before they act

commonThreats.description: Champion Warrens expeditions add the Swine Skiver, whose backline attacks combine heavy damage with stun, movement, blight, and debuffs.
counters: Pull or shuffle the Skiver forward

resistanceTendencies.note: Warrens enemies are generally more practical bleed targets than blight targets, though individual and higher-tier resistances still vary.
Swinefolk commonly resist blight, with resistance increasing at higher expedition difficulties.
Small backline enemies are often controllable, while large enemies and Champion variants resist stun more strongly.
Movement is especially valuable against Swinetaur and Swine Skiver, but reliability falls against larger or higher-tier targets.

recommendedCapabilities: Clear marks or protect marked heroes
cautions: Do not build the party's primary damage-over-time plan around blight without checking individual resistance.
Do not let a Swine Wretch or Drummer act repeatedly while attacking a low-pressure frontline enemy.
Veteran and Champion expeditions require a plan for large enemies and disruptive party-wide attacks.
Champion expeditions require immediate control or displacement of the Swine Skiver.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Enemy types

priorityReasons: Deals straightforward health damage with broader reach than many basic frontliners.
Usually presents less lasting risk than active backline stress or ranged enemies.

dangerousActions.name: Graveyard Slash
dangerousActions.description: A direct melee attack that can reach beyond the frontmost hero.
counters: Move it to the backmost position

effectiveResponses: Remove it after more urgent backline threats unless immediate health damage is the greater concern.
Use blight or Unholy bonuses when convenient.
cautions: At higher difficulties it may begin stealthed, delaying direct targeting without destealth.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Soldier

priorityReasons: Tempting Goblet inflicts stress that persists beyond the current fight.
High speed often lets it act before slower heroes.
traits: Low early move and stun resistance

dangerousActions.name: Tempting Goblet
dangerousActions.description: Attacks any hero from the back ranks, inflicting substantial stress and later a critical-chance debuff.
counters: Pull or shuffle it to enemy position 1

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it when expedition stress is a concern.
Pulling it to the front forces a much weaker attack pattern.
cautions: Enemy position 2 may still allow Tempting Goblet, so a partial pull is not a complete shutdown.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Courtier

priorityReasons: Quarrel delivers strong backline health damage with meaningful critical potential.
It preferentially threatens marked heroes.

dangerousActions.name: Quarrel
dangerousActions.description: A strong ranged attack against the party backline that is more dangerous to marked heroes.
counters: Pull it into the front two positions

effectiveResponses: Disable or kill it before it repeatedly pressures fragile backliners.
A successful pull replaces Quarrel with its weaker Bayonet Jab until it retreats.
cautions: Bayonet Jab moves it backward, so movement disruption may need to be repeated.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Arbalist

priorityReasons: Its protection makes direct attacks inefficient.
Its damage pressure is usually lower than the enemies it accompanies.

dangerousActions.name: Dead Weight
dangerousActions.description: Hits a front hero and can stun and knock the target backward.

effectiveResponses: Leave it until urgent backline enemies are controlled.
Use blight or armor piercing instead of inefficient direct damage.
cautions: Dead Weight can still disrupt a position-dependent frontline even when the Defender is left for last.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Defender

priorityReasons: Its attacks have broad reach and high critical potential.
Impale damages the entire party while it remains in the front.

dangerousActions.name: Spear Thrust
dangerousActions.description: A strong attack that can reach any hero and knock the target backward.

dangerousActions.name: Impale
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide attack available while the Spearman occupies the enemy front.
counters: Push it out of the front two positions

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it before low-pressure defenders.
Stun it or push it backward to prevent Impale.
cautions: Spear Thrust remains usable from any enemy position, so pushing it back only removes Impale.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Spearman

priorityReasons: Ground Pound can stun the entire party.
Crushing Blow combines high frontline damage with reduced stun resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Crushing Blow
dangerousActions.description: Heavy frontline damage that reduces the target's stun resistance.

dangerousActions.name: Ground Pound
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide attack that can stun multiple heroes.

effectiveResponses: Use blight, armor piercing, or protection reduction.
Damage reduction is useful when its high resistances make direct control unreliable.
cautions: Do not assume a stun or move attempt will reliably disable this large enemy.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Captain

priorityReasons: Passively increases allied damage and can add further offensive buffs.
Unholy Rally revives corpses at full health as an automatic action.

dangerousActions.name: Wicked Surge
dangerousActions.description: Improves another enemy's accuracy and damage.

dangerousActions.name: Unholy Rally
dangerousActions.description: Automatically revives an available enemy corpse at full health.
counters: Use attacks that leave no corpse
Kill the Bearer before more enemies die

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate Champion-tier priority.
Use corpse clearing while working through enemies that screen it.
cautions: Repeated stun attempts are not a dependable plan because its stun resistance is exceptionally high.
Ignoring corpses allows defeated enemies to return at full health.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Bone Bearer

priorityReasons: Its durable frontline presence delivers bleed and disruptive stun or knockback.
Fragile Warrens support enemies usually create greater lasting risk and should often be removed first.

dangerousActions.name: Butcher Cut
dangerousActions.description: A frontline attack that causes bleed and at higher difficulty reduces healing received.

dangerousActions.name: Ball and Chain
dangerousActions.description: Targets the party backline and can stun and knock the victim backward.

effectiveResponses: Control it while eliminating Wretches, Drummers, or Skivers behind it.
Exploit its relatively low bleed resistance instead of relying on movement.
cautions: Leaving it for later is not harmless when bleed or party displacement threatens an already weakened hero.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Chopper

priorityReasons: Hook Where It Hurts reaches the first three heroes from any enemy position and has high critical potential.
Later variants reduce bleed and disease resistance, amplifying other Warrens threats.
traits: Stealth at Veteran and Champion difficulty

dangerousActions.name: Hook Where It Hurts
dangerousActions.description: A high-critical attack that later reduces bleed and disease resistance; the Slasher moves itself backward after attacking.

effectiveResponses: Remove it early when its resistance debuff would expose the party to disease or bleed follow-ups.
Use attacks that bypass protection and can reach it after it retreats.
cautions: Pulling it forward does not disable its attack because Hook Where It Hurts is usable from every enemy position.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Slasher

priorityReasons: Vomit inflicts persistent expedition costs through stress and random disease.
High speed and access to every hero let it create risk before slower parties can respond.

dangerousActions.name: Vomit
dangerousActions.description: Targets any hero for stress and a chance of random disease, adding a dodge debuff at higher difficulty.

effectiveResponses: Prioritize it when expedition stress or disease would be costly.
Use its low health and early control resistances to prevent repeated Vomit attacks.
cautions: Its speed means a slow party may still suffer one Vomit before removing it.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Wretch

priorityReasons: Drum of Doom inflicts stress across the party.
Its mark and dodge debuff enable stronger follow-up attacks from other Warrens enemies.

dangerousActions.name: Drum of Doom
dangerousActions.description: Inflicts stress on the entire party from the enemy backline.

dangerousActions.name: Drum of Debilitation
dangerousActions.description: Marks one hero and reduces dodge, setting up allied attacks.

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an early target because both actions increase expedition-level risk.
Pulling or shuffling it away from the back ranks restricts its support pattern.
cautions: Judge its priority together with enemies that exploit marked targets; the combination is more dangerous than either enemy alone.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Drummer

priorityReasons: From the back ranks it can use a party-wide attack or a powerful charge with stun and knockback.
Its large health pool and protection make an unfocused damage race inefficient.

dangerousActions.name: Pig Spear
dangerousActions.description: A party-wide ranged attack used from the rear enemy positions.

dangerousActions.name: Boar Rush
dangerousActions.description: A powerful charge from the rear that can stun and knock a hero backward while moving the Swinetaur forward.

effectiveResponses: Eliminate its allies and their corpses so its size traps it in enemy position 1.
In the front it is restricted to the weaker Crunching Backhand before using Trot Retreat to reposition.
cautions: Direct movement and stun attempts can be unreliable because of its high resistances.
Leaving corpses or another enemy in front gives it room to regain its dangerous rear-position pattern.

priorityReasons: Spit to Roast combines heavy damage, stun, and knockback and preferentially threatens marked heroes.
Cripple Them attacks three heroes while applying blight and combat debuffs.

dangerousActions.name: Spit to Roast
dangerousActions.description: A severe single-target attack from the rear that stuns and knocks the victim backward, with increased danger to marked heroes.
counters: Pull the Skiver to enemy position 1

dangerousActions.name: Cripple Them
dangerousActions.description: Attacks party positions 2 through 4 together, applying blight and reducing dodge and speed.
counters: Pull the Skiver to enemy position 1

effectiveResponses: Treat it as an immediate Champion-tier priority.
Pull or shuffle it into enemy position 1, where it must use the weaker Goring Flight to move backward.
cautions: Goring Flight restores its access to dangerous backline attacks, so displacement may need to be repeated.
A marked hero makes Spit to Roast especially urgent.

sources.title: Official Darkest Dungeon Wiki: Swine Skiver
